text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ouch... My skin just doesn't seem to be getting any better.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the moisturizing cream isn't working.
Even though it was the expert's top recommendation...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...! My recommendation rank dropped to 2nd place.
Could it be that because of that—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
N-No. Surely it has nothing to do with that.
...What an unpleasant coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's skin irritation
just wouldn't seem to clear up...
